summary.tldr: Sets hours-of-service rules for extra-provincial motor carriers and exempts certain livestock and insect trips from those counts near trip endpoints.
what_it_does: Creates daily driving and on-duty limits for drivers of extra-provincial motor carrier undertakings, based on hours set by regulation.
Requires drivers to take prescribed off-duty hours before driving again after reaching the daily driving or on-duty limit.
Defines a driver’s day as a 24-hour period that starts at a carrier-designated hour, if that start time is used for at least seven straight days.
Exempts hours spent within 240 kilometres of the origin or final destination of a trip from service-hour counts when the driver is transporting livestock or insects.
Gives regulations power to define terms such as driver, on-duty time and off-duty time, and to prescribe other matters under the Act.
summary.background: The bill amends the Motor Vehicle Transport Act and adds new rules under its hours-of-service provisions.
